g.text: Runs Lighthouse and captures browser performance measurements under controlled network & CPU profiles.
Engine: Headless Chrome · Profiles: Mobile (4G throttled) & Desktop · Invariant: Empirical facts only, zero speculation
Normalizes metrics, audits, resources, scripts, images, fonts, and long tasks into standardized units (ms).
Contract: ZyraEvidence Schema v1.0 · Metrics: LCP, CLS, INP, FCP, TBT, Speed Index · Strict contract validation
Applies deterministic thresholds and performance rules across metrics, JavaScript execution, networks, fonts, and images.
Catalog: 16 Built-in Rules · Severities: CRITICAL, HIGH, WARNING, INFO · Grounded in W3C and Core Web Vitals criteria
Safely inspects framework, routes, imports, assets, configuration, and project structure without code execution.
Guarantees: Strictly read-only · Symlink escape protection · Excludes sensitive secrets (.env, keys) · Size-capped
Connects browser evidence with relevant codebase evidence via bundler-hash stripping and dynamic route matching.
Rules: CORR_IMAGE_ASSET, CORR_FONT_ASSET, CORR_SCRIPT_IMPORT, CORR_ROUTE_ENTRY · Bounded confidence [0.0 - 1.0]
Distinguishes observed facts, contributors, supported causes, and uncertainty with explicit confidence levels.
Doctrine: Anti-hallucination · Labels unconfirmed anomalies UNKNOWN or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE · Transparent rationale
Creates constrained, safe, reversible fix plans with optimistic concurrency checks and transactional rollback protection.
Strategies: 6 Built-in Fix Strategies · Dry-run simulation · SHA-256 preflight content hashes · Atomic rollback journal
Measures again after changes under identical network conditions, device profiles, and URL origin/pathnames.
Execution: Live Chrome run or pre-captured payload · Supports bounded repeat runs (1-5) to identify environmental jitter
Determines improvement, regression, or inconclusive results against deterministic noise-significance floors.
Invariant: APPLIED != IMPROVED · Noise filtering (LCP 100ms, CLS 0.02, TBT 50ms) · Decisions: KEEP_FIX, ROLLBACK_RECOMMENDED
Detects performance regressions deterministically in automation against authoritative production baselines.
Pipeline Exit Codes: 0=PASS, 1=FAIL, 2=WARN, 3=INCONCLUSIVE, 4=ERROR · Web Vitals budgets · GitHub PR comment markdown
